stories.title: The Brother's Royal Ring
stories.summary: The imprisoned brother accepts the baron's royal ring for a glass pyramid and 350000 experience, then leaves. The ring is worn by the baron on his balcony; supplied rings qualify. This records the delivery and reward, while the proposed change of ruler remains untracked.

steps.text: Optional: obtain the upper-prison key from the mage
steps.hint: Returning his locket supplies the key to the upper-prison gates. Supplied keys, an open route or supplied ring can avoid this history.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a royal ring of Bloodstone
steps.hint: The baron wears this ring on his balcony. The reception gate uses the blue-fish key, and the upper royal gate uses the sapphire key. Remove the ring before a native turn-in. Supplied copies qualify.

steps.text: Bring the exact offering to the baron's brother
steps.hint: Reward: a glass pyramid, 350000 experience. The giver leaves afterward.

stories.title: The Mage's Lost Locket
stories.summary: Return the golden locket from the pregnant corpse at the forest altar. The mage awards the upper-prison key and 25000 experience, then leaves. The key opens two upper-prison gate pairs. Supplied lockets and keys can avoid this preparation; the exchange does not prove the cells were visited.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a golden locket
steps.hint: Get the exact locket out of the pregnant corpse at the forest altar. The northern forest path is concealed and closed at reset, with no key requirement. Carry the locket directly rather than offering its container.

steps.text: Bring the exact offering to an ailing mage
steps.hint: Reward: a blue skeleton key, 25000 experience. The giver leaves afterward.

stories.title: The Numbaca Ingredients
stories.summary: The captain's wife needs five distinct ingredients together, including the missionary head returned by the captain. She awards a red pendant and 100000 experience. The bloody scalp has no confirmed ordinary source in the reviewed data. Her Pellops instructions have no implemented follow-on exchange, so this entry ends at the pendant reward.

steps.text: Optional: obtain the blood soaked head of a Verzanan missionary
steps.hint: This producer receipt is one preparation route. Supplied components are accepted, and the final exchange still consumes the actual item.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a bloody head
steps.hint: Ordinary bloody heads occur at the execution platform, inside its basket, and on the meditation platform. The wife accepts this kind; the mother's same-item return is rejection feedback.

steps.hint: This exact bloody ear lies on the meditation platform. The nearby portal in the tight passage or the garden's ring ladder can lead there; personal travel is not recorded by carrying it.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a bloody scalp
steps.hint: The exact bloody scalp has a prototype but no confirmed active reset or custom producer in the reviewed source paths. Supplied or recovered stock can still satisfy delivery. Check availability before planning the Numbaca commission.

steps.text: Carry 1 x some pink entrails
steps.hint: A human slave on the initial slave-platform placement carries these entrails. Other same-prototype placements do not each carry another copy. Supplied stock qualifies.

steps.hint: The captain awards this head for the original missionary head. Both share a displayed name, but the wife needs this returned kind. The original does not substitute.

steps.text: Bring the exact offering to a woman
steps.hint: Reward: a red pendant, 100000 experience. The giver stays after the exchange, if present. No second Pellops exchange or completed takeover is implemented.

steps.hint: Reward: a shiny flute, 25000 experience. The giver stays after the exchange, if present.

introduction: Bloodstone connects the lost locket and upper prison, royal-ring reward, four distinct amulet quarters, missionary proof and unfinished Numbaca plot. Independent local commissions sit beside distant artifact and alchemy recipes. Discovery and player progress require active accounting. Topic words explain the story; they are not separate achievements.
orientation: The forest and regional approaches lead through glowing spheres to the drawbridge and keep. These portals use enter; confirmed travel is separate from a turn-in receipt. The drawbridge and keep gate are open routes in the reviewed data.

The golden locket lies inside the pregnant corpse at the forest altar, beyond the concealed northern path. Return it to the ailing mage for the upper-prison key. Supplied lockets or keys can avoid earlier history.

Ordinary prison access uses the prison key sold by local tavern contacts. The upper gates use the mage's blue skeleton key. Grey and blue cell keys are separate. Some black-key doors described as locked actually reset closed but unlocked; do not assume every prose barrier needs a key.

A blue fish supplies the reception key to the Forbidden Tower. The mistress supplies or carries the sapphire key for the upper royal chambers. The baron wears the royal ring and carries the fourth amulet quarter; these fund separate exchanges.

The mother, father and Faust supply three different quarters and leave after their rewards. The baron carries the fourth. The high mage requires all four distinct kinds together, despite their identical displayed names.

The captain transforms the missionary's original head into a different same-named head for his wife. Her other exact ingredients include a bloody scalp with no confirmed ordinary producer. Her pendant reward points toward Pellops, but the follow-on exchange is absent.

The fisherman's lizard request supplies Asmond's flute. The old woman's mistress-proof reward mentions Ferris; Ferris's minotaur lyre supplies a captain clue and experience, rather than an amulet quarter. These clues do not themselves record learned topics.

Sabrina requires both baby item kinds at once. The ordinary bloody head returned by the mother is rejection feedback. Delivery of loaded trophies does not prove personal combat, a rescue, freshness or a faction choice.

The ring ladder in the vegetable garden and the tight-passage portal provide routes to the meditation platform's bones, ear and ordinary head. Get offerings out of containers and remove equipment before a native turn-in.

Moldar, Sark, Navift, Fibblefinger and Hedvig have no confirmed ordinary active placements in the reviewed sources. Their recipe guidance is still useful for supplied or recovered stock and later builder integration; verify that the actual recipient is present.

Winterhaven provides plain equipment, ingots, blueprint routes, hilts, armor flints and the binding-orb exchange. Each artifact needs its exact upgraded base and distant components. Several component sources remain unconfirmed; separate recipes keep separate ownership.

Bloodstone's Storm legplates recipe needs rolling thunder and Gaia's blessing. Winterhaven instead requires ten maelstrom components alongside the base, orb and flint. Equal rewards do not imply equal inputs or a shared completion.

Fibblefinger requires six planar essences and five potion kinds for two elixirs. Winterhaven and Alatorin use different recipes for the same reward. The generic attribute-scroll transformation chooses one random kind; Hedvig needs two matching scrolls for each basic earring.

The nine-earring finale costs 500000 copper and is currently unavailable under active accounting. Maelborg's stat shop also refuses active-accounting purchases. The ordinary inn and Cerrio's separate world-quest service have their own service rules, without local story completion.

Fresh reset supply and committed scripted transformations still need qualification. Supplied items can satisfy delivery; inventory readiness, keys, topic words and reward prose do not establish personal acquisition or every earlier stage.
